scripts.build: tsc --noEmit && vite build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); for(const f of ['index.html','icon-192.png','icon-512.png','manifest.webmanifest']) fs.copyFileSync('dist/'+f, f);"
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.android:release: npm run cap:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
